hero.title: Java backend developer
hero.subtitle: Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · REST APIs
hero.description: Specializing in Java and Spring Boot backend development, microservices and REST APIs. At NTT DATA, I also build interfaces with Thymeleaf and JavaScript. Full stack experience with Angular, Ionic and Laravel.

profile.title: About me
profile.description: Before moving into software, I worked as a physiotherapist. Today I specialize in Java backend development, with the same attention to understanding problems and the people using each solution. My work also includes frontend development with Thymeleaf and JavaScript, connecting data and business logic with the interface. My previous Angular and Laravel experience complements that view of the full application flow.

responsibilities: Development and maintenance of backend features with Java 17 and Spring Boot, in a microservices architecture.
Full Stack development of enterprise applications, building interfaces with Thymeleaf and JavaScript and integrating them with business logic.
Work in microservices environments deployed on Docker and Kubernetes, using Maven for builds and dependency management.
Development and optimization of SQL queries in MySQL, working with data persistence in enterprise applications.
Development and maintenance of REST APIs with Laravel and PHP, including backend features and SQL queries.
Development of interfaces and cross-platform applications with Angular, TypeScript and Ionic, integrated with backend services over HTTP.
Participation in mobile application development with React Native, working on backend integration.
Implementation of Android features with Java, contributing to different phases of software development.

projects.holyWeekAppDecision: Persistent caching with MMKV and a bundled fallback catalogue keep brotherhood information available offline, refreshing data from the REST API when available.

projects.project4Decision: A rich domain model keeps business rules and validation alongside the data they protect.

transition.title: From Physiotherapy to Code
transition.subtitle: Three ways that experience shapes my work.
transition.card1Text: Break a problem down, test hypotheses and check the outcome: from clinical diagnosis to debugging software.
transition.card3Text: Organizing records and treatments taught me to care about data, processes and following tasks through.
transition.card5Text: Learning, applying and reviewing what I learn is part of my work, first in healthcare and now in technology.
